added.role: Qubit-added contract test for the /qubit-chat voice-status strip (active engine, Right-Ctrl state, privacy/fallback reason); no upstream counterpart.
Qubit-added contract test for the Qubit-owned WS-ticket client (`POST /agent/api/auth/ws-ticket`) that the /chat terminal upgrade uses; no upstream counterpart.
Qubit-added /qubit-chat artifacts panel: renders the canonical session comments, structured CI-detail rows, and per-session drafts from the Qubit chat-transport authority; no upstream counterpart.
Qubit-added /agents workspace: renders the canonical GET /api/qubit/agents roster (worker lane + runtime adapters, read-only); no upstream counterpart.
Qubit-added contract test for the /agents workspace (roster render + refresh), with no upstream counterpart.

Qubit-added static plugin-fleet discovery: fetch <base>/plugins/fleet.json (SPA-shipped manifests) and resolve each manifest's asset root. Keeps the vendored compatibility backend as the operation authority while surfacing the real pinned plugin tabs.

Qubit-authored static fleet manifest aggregate: mirrors the two pinned dashboard manifests (tab paths/positions, entry, css) with a Qubit-neutral description; verified by tests/test_dashboard_plugin_fleet.py::test_static_fleet_manifest_mirrors_pinned_plugins.

Qubit-added product-identity normalizer applied at the render boundary to backend free-text (MCP/Channels/Config) so served pages never expose an upstream product name; upstream names remain only in vendored source/provenance records.
Qubit-added contract test for the System page power/e-stop control (live latch badge, confirm-dialog latch -> powerAction('emergency-stop'), latched reset state); no upstream counterpart.

Qubit-added contract test for the Qubit-native chat-session store sidebar (ChatSessionList.tsx): pins `api.listChatSessions`, the rendered rows, refresh, and the `?resume=<id>` selection driving the persisted SSE transcript (no upstream counterpart; the vendored component test is absent).

Qubit-added typed policy-refusal helper: parses the backend's typed denied envelope (code, detail, qubit_counterpart) so dashboard actions render honest guidance instead of a raw error (no upstream counterpart).
Qubit-added unit test for the typed policy-refusal helper.

Qubit-added connection-latency sampler for the dashboard shell: EWMA-smoothed gateway round-trip plus a shared human-readable formatter. Plain value object (no timers/DOM); the shell owns the sampling cadence.
Qubit-added unit test for the latency sampler (EWMA smoothing, rejected invalid/negative samples, reset, and formatting).
Qubit-added contract test for the /docs OpenAPI reference (drift A23): renders the served OAS operations grouped by namespace and narrowed by the header search input.
Qubit-added contract test for the /env six-tab surface (drift A22): every section is structural with an empty catalog and each header tab jumps to its card.

Qubit-added contract test for the /models provider-profile 'Use as' actions (drift A20): one action per profile, aria-pressed on the active one, and a click routed through the canonical setActiveProfile op.
Qubit-added contract test for the /skills category filter and live header search (drift A21), including the typed empty state when nothing matches.

Qubit-added authenticated SSE reader for the single Qubit event path (`GET /api/events/stream`, served by `voicebridge/webui.py:_events_stream`): fetch + ReadableStream/TextDecoder frame parser (because `EventSource` cannot attach the dashboard auth header), `?last_seq=` journal replay cursor, id/event/data frames, comment heartbeats, and the `resync` overflow sentinel. No upstream counterpart: the vendored sidebar used WebSockets, which Qubit refuses with HTTP 426 `WS_SINGLE_PATH`.

Qubit-added unit test for the SSE frame parser and replay-URL builder (partial-tail buffering, heartbeat/retry-block filtering, multi-line data joins, the resync sentinel, and base-path/cursor handling).

Qubit-added canonical chat-route predicate (owner chat mapping): `/chat` and `/qubit-chat` are the two equivalent chat routes rendering the single shared ChatPage host. Keeps host visibility, header layout, and nav highlighting on one source of truth so the routes cannot drift into a second implementation. No upstream counterpart.
Qubit-added unit test for the canonical chat-route predicate (both routes match, trailing slash tolerated, prefix collisions rejected).

Qubit-added `/chat` terminal frontend: mounts the vendored xterm terminal and streams the real vendor PTY over the single Qubit WebSocket upgrade path (`/agent/api/pty`) with a short-lived single-use scoped ticket. `/qubit-chat` keeps the Qubit-native ChatPage (owner decision 2026-09-17).

removed.reason: Removed by the 2026-09-17 owner chat mapping: `/qubit-chat` is no longer a card-only overlay page; it is a built-in SPA route rendering the same ChatPage as `/chat`.
Removed with the card-only `/qubit-chat` overlay plugin (owner chat mapping 2026-09-17).

provenance_schema.purpose: Per-file provenance for every vendored Hermes/OpenClaw file. Unmodified source stays byte-identical; every divergence is a documented Qubit patch with a regression test.

fields.upstream_blob_sha256: sha256 of the pinned upstream blob content; identical to upstream_sha256 (kept for the dashboard-rebuild contract wording). null when the file has no upstream counterpart.
fields.qubit: vendored local path (or null when intentionally omitted)
fields.qubit_sha256: sha256 of the on-disk vendored file
fields.patch: exact patch id / rebrand description; null when the vendored file is byte-identical to upstream
fields.reason: why the patch/add exists and what behaviour it affects
fields.affected_regression_test: on-disk test that fails if the divergence or provenance record regresses

provenance_schema.added_files: Qubit-authored files with no upstream counterpart live under wave3.added / wave4.added, each with qubit_sha256, role, and affected_regression_test.
